summary: Magnum Ice Cream Company N.V. furnished a Form 6-K attaching a stock exchange announcement dated September 17, 2026, updating shareholders on the voting outcome for Resolution 5 (Foundation Plan for Growth) from its AGM held May 7, 2026. While 77.37% voted in favor, more than 20% opposed, triggering a UK Corporate Governance Code update statement. The Board engaged shareholders, concluded no further actions are necessary, and will provide updates in its 2026 Annual Report. This is a routine governance disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
